A move is made of many small preparations.

Once Australia becomes a real plan, the practical questions arrive quickly. Use this list to keep track of what you want to check before travel, one step at a time.

Start with your own visa and travel documents.

This is a general planning list, not a visa checklist or travel clearance. Each person's visa, passport, health cover, and items to bring can be different. Follow the current instructions for every traveller in your household.
